teaser.en: Swahili speakers everywhere know *mchicha*, but this tall amaranth goes by the same name in Digo gardens.
teaser.sw: Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kila mahali wanaujua *mchicha*, na mchicha huu mrefu huitwa kwa jina hilo hilo katika bustani za Kidigo.
teaser.dg: Atu anaogomba Chiswahili chila phatu anamanya *mchicha*, ela *mchicha* huno mrefu piya unaihwa vivyo busitani za Adigo.

summary.en: *Mchicha* is a tall amaranth grown in gardens and farms. Its leaves are cooked as greens, one of the most common vegetables of the coast.
summary.sw: *Mchicha* ni mchicha mrefu unaolimwa bustanini na mashambani. Majani yake hupikwa kama mboga ya majani, mojawapo ya mboga za kawaida zaidi pwani.
summary.dg: *Mchicha* (kpwa Chingereza *amaranth*) ni mmea mrefu unaorimwa busitani na minda. Makodzage nkujitwa dza mboga, na ni kahi ya mboga zinazoriwa sana pwani.

about.en: *Mchicha* is a tall, leafy herb with oval leaves on long stalks and dense spikes of tiny green or reddish flowers at the tips. It grows fast and can be harvested by picking leaves again and again.
about.sw: *Mchicha* ni mmea mrefu wenye majani mengi, wenye majani yenye umbo la yai juu ya vikonyo virefu na vishada vilivyoshonana vya maua madogo sana ya kijani au mekundu kiasi kwenye ncha. Hukua haraka na unaweza kuvunwa kwa kuchuma majani tena na tena.
about.dg: *Mchicha* ni mmea mrefu wenye makodza manji, ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, kpwenye milita mirefu. Kpwenye ntsaze kuna punga zirizogbwirana za maruwa madide sana, ga chijani au ga kundu chidide. Unamera upesi, na unaweza kuvunwa kpwa kungobola makodza tsona na tsona.

where.en: It is grown in gardens and on farms across the south coast.
where.sw: Hulimwa bustanini na mashambani kote katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Unarimwa busitani na minda pwani yosi ya kusini.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked as greens.
uses.sw: Majani hupikwa kama mboga ya majani.

names.en: The Digo name is *mchicha*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is amaranth or pigweed. Digo also uses *mtsunga* for vegetables, especially amaranths.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mchicha*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *amaranth* au *pigweed*. Kidigo pia hutumia *mtsunga* kwa mboga za majani, hasa michicha.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mchicha*, sawa na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *amaranth* au *pigweed*. Chidigo piya china neno *mtsunga* kpwa mboga, hasa mchicha.

reason.en: Another leafy green of the garden
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya bustanini
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza ya busitani.

reason.en: Another leaf vegetable eaten with ugali
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani inayoliwa kwa ugali
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza inayoriwa na sima.

reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani ya nyumbani
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza ya midzini.
